items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I understand that my, my favorite around here... My favorite is George Mraz.

ctx.x: Slam had a great ear, and then of course, he studied violin before he played bass and he had all that knowledge of harmony.

I understand that my, my favorite around here... My favorite is George Mraz. I understand he's having trouble with his left hand. You know, he studied violin for twelve years. And he's got tendinitis or something in his left hand. And that's not good! That's not good at all. He should watch it. Because he is fantastic!
